claims.content: If an alerting force tell alert on a selected reference point or area was initiated on alert in the PDSI TM, as specified above, if Mission TM does not already have the FT ID set, then the alert is terminated at the reference points or area, the ZU terminating the alert shall also terminate the alert by setting the applicable mission TM force tell status of FT ID and set it to the cleared point or area alert value indicated.
A ZU terminating a force tell alert on a track shall also terminate the alert on that track by clearing the force tell alert on any reference point or area that is placed to the track.
